summary: This report discusses the upcoming round of collective bargaining negotiations between Toronto Parking Authority and Toronto Parking Authority's Union TCEU Local 416.
decided: The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the recommendations outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 25, 2021) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Directed the President, Toronto Parking Authority, in consultation with the Chief People Officer and the Executive Director, Social Development, Finance and Administration, to report back to the next meeting of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority on the Equity Impacts of the proposed direction for the collective agreement negotiation, using the City of Toronto's equity impact analysis and feedback from the External Review Panel, if practicable and appropriate in the discretion of the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 25, 2021) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety as it contains information pertaining to labour relations and employee negotiations.
